data_objects.name: basketball_play_by_play
data_objects.meaning: Basketball play-by-play event records with game and event identifiers, coded event types, period and clock fields, team-oriented event descriptions, and score state.

variables.name: GAME_ID
variables.meaning: Identifier for the basketball game containing the event.

variables.name: EVENTNUM
variables.meaning: Sequential event number within the game.

variables.name: EVENTMSGTYPE
variables.meaning: Numeric categorical code for the broad event-message type; the codebook is not supplied.

variables.name: EVENTMSGACTIONTYPE
variables.meaning: Numeric categorical code for the event action subtype; the codebook is not supplied.

variables.name: PERIOD
variables.meaning: Game period number associated with the event.

variables.name: WCTIMESTRING
variables.meaning: Wall-clock time string recorded for the event.

variables.name: PCTIMESTRING
variables.meaning: Period-clock time string associated with the event, representing game-clock time remaining.

variables.name: HOMEDESCRIPTION
variables.meaning: Textual event description from the home-team side when applicable.

variables.name: NEUTRALDESCRIPTION
variables.meaning: Textual neutral event description when applicable.

variables.name: VISITORDESCRIPTION
variables.meaning: Textual event description from the visiting-team side when applicable.

variables.name: SCORE
variables.meaning: Formatted score state recorded after or at the event; team ordering in the string is not stated.

variables.name: SCOREMARGIN
variables.meaning: Score-margin value associated with the event; the sign convention and team perspective are not stated.

structure.description: Each row represents one recorded event within a game; GAME_ID and EVENTNUM provide the game and event-sequence context.
PERIOD and PCTIMESTRING locate an event within game time, while WCTIMESTRING records civil clock time.
Home, neutral, and visitor descriptions occupy separate fields according to the event's descriptive perspective.

uncertainties: Event-code mappings, clock timezone, score-string team ordering, and score-margin perspective are not provided.
Blank description or score cells do not distinguish inapplicability from unavailable recording.
annotation_notes: Semantics are limited to the column labels, clock formats, and event text visible in train.csv.
